modules.title: Master transactional upgrade/orchestration layer
modules.notes: Transactional backups + SHA-256 manifests, baseline conflict detection (Force never bypasses), secret redaction, state machine (pending/applied/verified-local/verified-backend/verified-native/failed/rolled-back), per-module and ALL/resume orchestration. Verified by tests/upgrade-orchestrator.test.js which drives Test-HeyUpgrade.ps1 (8 assertions).

modules.title: Canonical HEY core contracts and execution architecture
modules.notes: Shared contract layer: RequestContext, capability registry, execution controller, HEYError taxonomy, EventEnvelope, artifact engine. Verified execution results only; audit receipts; cancellation/progress support. Covered by journeys + security-regressions suites.

modules.title: Premium adaptive design system, shell, landing benchmark, responsive behavior
modules.notes: 27 themed design tokens; every theme passes >=4.5:1 contrast checks for action labels and body text; invalid custom accents rejected. Premium restrained landing direction. Verified by theme-studio.test.js.

modules.title: Persistent multimodal conversation surface
modules.notes: Persistent conversations via chatTransport; message routing; completion runtime forwards OS notifications into the notification center. Conversation persistence + HEY.remember journey covered by tests/journeys.test.js. completionRuntime is browser-only (window at import) so it is verified by presence + the notify path tests.

modules.title: Hands-free natural realtime-capable Voice with free-first provider stack
modules.notes: Free-first provider stack; honest unavailable/offline/permission states; state machine rejects impossible transitions; wake-word boundary matching. Dedicated /voice surface in the nav catalog. Real microphone/TTS cannot be headless-verified; provider behavior covered with mocks.

modules.title: Private timeline + semantic memory graph + retrieval intelligence
modules.notes: Automatic memories gate in an approval inbox; approved memories persist into a searchable memory graph; rejection writes a decision receipt. Multiple abstractions exist (memoryGraph, memoryEngine, memoryGraphService...); consolidation is tracked as a candidate in Module 32 and requires a migration plan before removal.

modules.title: 229 built-in specialists + custom executable agents and teams
modules.notes: 229 canonical agents (IDs 843-1071). Agent execution fails closed without a verified provider; unverified outputs rejected; verified outputs accepted. Covered by release-surfaces.test.js.

modules.title: Safe builder for agents, teams, workflows, skills, commands, automations, widgets and capabilities
modules.notes: Forge validates capabilities and never self-authorizes; generated artifacts run through the same permission/verification gates. Fail-closed tested in release-surfaces.test.js (forgeRunner returns success=false without real runner).

modules.title: Durable workflows, schedules, triggers, retries and approvals
modules.notes: Verified workflows stop on reported failure, respect cancellation and maxAttempts; automation execution fails closed without a real provider; queued actions require identity+permission+confirmation+verified results. Covered by security-regressions + release-surfaces tests.

modules.title: Grounded research, web/source provenance, file intelligence and prompt-injection resistance
modules.notes: Natural command parsing produces typed workflow steps with validated URLs (YouTube example asserted); research missions require a real output before completion. File intelligence surfaces exist (filesEngine) with permission gating.

modules.title: Camera/screen/image perception pipeline with consent and verified observations
modules.notes: Vision rejects invalid input and missing providers without inventing observations (VISION_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE); only structured verified provider observations pass. Camera consent delegated to permission system.

modules.title: Real local-first media editing + pluggable AI generation
modules.notes: Local editing plan parser (trim/crop/resize/speed/compress); semantic requests separated from exact local transforms; AI-proposed plans strip unapproved operations (execute_shell removed). FFmpeg WASM is the local-first engine. Verified by mediaEditPlan.test.js. Server-side hey-studio image generation is free-first: OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, otherwise a no-key Pollinations fallback (see module 31).

modules.title: Native verified computer control with scoped permissions and receipts
modules.notes: Adapters expose only declared executable capabilities; natural commands reach permission gates instead of self-approving; execution-time authorization re-checks plan/permission/risk/confirmation and ignores forged client overrides. Credentialed/screen-native control requires the Tauri native side (Module 23).

modules.title: Trusted device identity, pairing, capability negotiation and handoff
modules.notes: Device registry exposes capabilities without allowing fake remote execution (unavailable+unverified when no real transport); fabric negotiates device identity and 6-char pair codes and reports handoff honestly. Covered by journeys + platform-capabilities tests.

modules.title: Platform-native live status surface, not a fake universal overlay
modules.notes: Desktop island bridge + surface page exist; Tauri bridge stays inactive in a normal web runtime (no fake native). The true OS live-status surface requires the Windows/Tauri host (Module 23), which is EXTERNAL until a signed native build exists.

modules.title: Camera hand-gesture control with calibration, debouncing and safe action mapping
modules.notes: Gesture control surface + system gesture runtime exist; wake-word boundary detection is unit-tested. gestureControl reads import.meta.env at load (browser-only), so it is verified by presence. Camera gesture loops are browser-only and cannot run headless in Node; safe action mapping requires explicit permission gates.

modules.title: Persistent spatial workspace + widget runtime
modules.notes: Workspace engine + manager (persistent spatial workspace) and an Infinity action/evidence timeline exist; widget runtime is exercised through event bus + artifact persistence paths. Two workspace abstractions are candidate consolidation targets tracked in Module 32.

modules.title: Tasks, planner, calendar, reminders and time-aware intelligence
modules.notes: Tasks + calendar engine with time-aware intelligence; habit streaks computed on local calendar days with pending-today semantics; proactive engine surfaces overdue-task signals. Covered by fix-pass.test.js. tasksCalendarEngine logs a localStorage availability warning in Node but the module still loads and the pure helpers are unit-tested.

modules.title: Coherent HEY modes/workbenches without fragmenting the assistant
modules.notes: Surface modes + mode registry produce coherent workbenches on top of one assistant; mode engine, Crisis and Morning modes and the Modes page exist. No dedicated mode transition test yet; covered structurally by the app shell and catalog (source-implemented, NOT TESTED for mode transitions).

modules.title: Free-first multi-provider/model routing, health, fallback and future paid adapters
modules.notes: Provider router prefers compatible healthy higher-quality provider and honors localOnly; quality gate refuses empty output; provider descriptors carry cost/privacy/local fields so paid adapters can stay disabled by default. Covered by infinityRuntime.test.js.

modules.title: Auth lifecycle, profiles, RLS, rate limiting, trust center and security hardening
modules.notes: Execution-time authorization enforces user identity, plan, permission, consent and forged-client defenses; hydrated permissions cannot cross account boundaries; audit receipts on every decision. Auth lifecycle + RLS migrations exist server-side. Service-role secrets live server-side only.

modules.title: Future-proof Free/Pro/Elite entitlements with launch-free operation
modules.notes: Tier resolution from explicit plan/entitlements (unknown -> free); permission policy enforces tier boundaries; server-enforced via admin-entitlements edge function and RLS; launch works entirely on the free tier. Client plan/entitlement overrides are ignored at the execution boundary.

modules.title: Installable resilient mobile-first PWA with truthful platform limits
modules.notes: Service worker (install, notificationclick -> HEY_NOTIFICATION_OPEN) + manifest + install button; release matrix lists every HEY target without claiming unbuilt native releases. App badge sync and WCO adapter present with runtime-integrity coverage.

modules.title: Windows/Tauri native product integration
modules.notes: Tauri adapter stays inactive in a normal web runtime; WCO geometry adapters present. cargo check passes on the native adapter. Building a signed Windows installer is EXTERNAL (requires the Tauri CLI bundle step + signing); release status nativeBuildRequired.

modules.title: Android native/mobile integration with shared HEY core
modules.notes: Adaptive mobile surfaces + shared core; platform matrix marks Android honestly. Building an APK/AAB requires Java/Android SDK/ADB which are not installed on this host -> EXTERNAL_SETUP_REQUIRED (toolchain).

modules.title: iOS native integration using legitimate platform capabilities
modules.notes: Release matrix marks iOS as nativeProjectRequired and isReleaseVerified=false. iOS builds require macOS + Xcode + Apple signing which are unavailable on this Windows host -> EXTERNAL_SETUP_REQUIRED (hardware/signing). No fake iOS automation claims are made.

modules.title: Dream World prompt-to-interactive-world foundation using the right runtime
modules.notes: World Studio surface + world style engine + generation engine produce themed interactive worlds from prompts/theme choices (local-first theme application). Real AI generation (image/video) depends on provider keys and is EXTERNAL; local theme generation is source-implemented.

modules.title: Performance budgets, workers, caching, offline/recovery and resource governance
modules.notes: Offline engine + background keep-alive + service worker caching exist; health engine reports system state. Vite build emits only pre-existing chunk-size warnings (INEFFECTIVE_DYNAMIC_IMPORT) with no errors. No automated performance budget test yet -> NOT TESTED for byte-budget.

modules.title: Keyboard, screen-reader, motion, contrast, touch and cognitive accessibility
modules.notes: Contrast >=4.5:1 enforced across 27 themes, reduced-motion + compliance styles exist. Real screen-reader/keyboard end-to-end checks require a browser/AT environment -> manual verification item (EXTERNAL/physical-device).

modules.title: Local/free structured logs, traces, health and diagnostics
modules.notes: Logger, diagnostics engine, health engine and error taxonomy exist; upgrade orchestrator captures redacted, timed command logs with exit codes. Structured server-side tracing is a backend-deploy item (EXTERNAL).

modules.title: Comprehensive automated and manual evidence matrix
modules.notes: Full automated matrix: 60 tests across 10 files (journeys, platform capabilities, security regressions, release surfaces, runtime integrity, Infinity runtime, media edit plan, theme studio, fix-pass, upgrade orchestrator). Manual/browser-only journeys are recorded in HEY-KNOWN-LIMITS.md and the verification matrix.

modules.title: Free-first release pipeline, backend migrations, rollback, launch truthfulness
modules.notes: Four edge functions + 15 migrations; gitleaks secret-scan config; rollback and known-limits docs. hey-studio now ships a no-key free image path (Pollinations fallback when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent); video still requires LUMA_API_KEY and reports an honest unavailable state without it. Live deployment to the hosted Supabase project and VAPID-key provisioning are EXTERNAL (operator must run; recorded in docs/setup/API-SETUP.md).

modules.title: Cross-module consolidation, cleanup, evidence and release candidate
modules.notes: Final integration: durable status file, capability ledger (2039 entries), verification matrix, implementation report, setup doc, AGENTS.md + hey-finish command, and the full automated test matrix. Candidate consolidations (memory abstractions, providerRouter x2, computerControl x2, workspaceEngine x2, voice files) are documented in reports with migration plans; none are removed without replacement tests.

modules.title: OS-level control bridge and native ladder (Windows daemon, Android accessibility, iOS facts)
modules.notes: Honest external-control contract: action envelopes, allowlisted commands, risk gates, and confirmation requirements live in externalControlBridge (13/13 tests). Gesture bindings with the external. prefix route through the bridge and fail closed (nativeTransportUnavailable) in a plain web runtime. Windows Tauri daemon: cargo check passes, signed installer EXTERNAL. Android accessibility service: source scaffold only, needs Android SDK (EXTERNAL_SETUP_REQUIRED). iOS: third-party control barred by Apple policy; Live Activity/widgets only.
